identificationModule.officialTitle: Retrospective Analysis of the Use of CAR-T Cell Therapy in Patients With Hematological Malignancies in Spain

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Information on baseline patient characteristics, haematological disease, comorbidities and CAR-T therapy procedure (lymphodepletion schedule, infused product) will be collected. Early post-infusion toxicity and recurrence data will be collected. The grading of adverse effects will follow the EBMT and ASTCT guidelines. Finally, data will be collected to analyse survival and, in case of death, cause of death).

primaryOutcomes.description: Patients who relapse or progress at 6 month after CART infussion.
Patients who relapse or progress at 12 month after CART infussion.
Patients who relapse or progress at 24 month after CART infussion.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Rate of grade 3 or more of CRS and neurotoxicity
Patients who relapse or progress at 6, 12, 24 months from apheresis

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients \>18 y/o
* Patients receiving CAR-T cell therapy in Spain, since 2018.

Exclusion Criteria: T

* Patients receiving CART therapy as part of a clinical trial.
eligibilityModule.studyPopulation: Adult patients \>18, with hematologic malignancies (lymphoma, leukemia, myeloma) in which the use of CAR-T therapy is approved, undergoing CAR-T therapy in Spain.
